info.description: The Parking Reservations Pricing API provides detailed information on the pricing structures for reserving parking spaces. It allows users to retrieve current pricing data, including hourly, daily, and special rates applicable for different parking locations. This API is designed for developers integrating parking reservation functionalities into their applications, ensuring they can offer accurate and up-to-date pricing information to end-users. Typical consumers include mobile app developers, web platforms, and service providers in the transportation and logistics sectors.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current pricing details for making a reservation. It provides crucial information necessary for users to understand costs associated with their booking options.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve pricing information for reservations. This may include specific parameters that affect pricing calculations, such as reservation dates, session types, or any applicable discounts.

ListParkingReservationsPricingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected in a JSON format when retrieving pricing information for reservations.
